manifest.name: dsh-five-session-evolution
manifest.description: Evidence-backed project memory and reusable workflow candidates, automatically reviewed after every five ended DeepSeek Harness sessions.

scripts.check: node --check src/core.js && node --check src/index.js && node --check src/runner.js && node --check scripts/market-index.mjs

bundle.text:
# Host services (agents, storageDomain, model and preset registries) come from DSH.
- insert:
    - id: five-session-evolution
      name: dsh-five-session-evolution
      config:
        batchSize: 5
        injectMemory: true

readme.section: 五会话自进化 · Five-session Evolution
readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) · MIT · DeepSeek Harness 插件

**让项目经验积累下来：每五个不同的项目会话结束后，自动复盘一次，提炼有来源的经验与工作流候选，在后续会话中带入项目记忆。**

适合长期维护代码、反复调试、文档生产和其他有重复流程的项目。学习结果保存在 DSH 自己的持久存储中，按工作目录隔离；使用当前 DSH 默认模型，无需另配记忆服务账户。

```text
同一项目的 5 个不同会话结束
  → 持久队列
  → 独立、无工具的复盘 Agent
  → JSON 校验与来源检查

- 默认每 5 个不同的根会话组成一批，可配置为 2–20 个。
- 同一会话 ID 只计一次；恢复后再次关闭，计数保持原值。
- 子 Agent、插件自身复盘会话，以及标记为 automation / subagent / goal 的自动会话跳过。
- 每条经验和每个工作流候选必须引用本批至少两个不同的会话 ID。插件校验来源 ID 和结果结构；事实正确性仍需结合当前项目核对。
- 有新证据时，同名主题经验与同名候选更新；默认保留最近 30 条经验、20 个候选和 100 次复盘记录。
- 待处理批次跨重启保留。失败按 60 秒、120 秒退避，默认第 3 次失败后暂停该项目的队首批次，等待手动重试。
- 同一个 DSH Host 内，复盘按顺序执行。成功结果与批次出队在同一持久记录中提交，避免重复应用学习结果。
这是运行层的经验积累与流程提炼，模型权重保持原样。工作流候选以草稿记录保存，安装和执行由用户决定；项目源代码、既有技能和宿主提示词由原有流程管理。

初版面向 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.5、Node.js 22+**。依赖 DSH 的 Agent、模型、预设、工具和 storageDomain 服务。插件包自带组合补丁，启用后挂载一个 Host 插件行。

在 DSH 的插件管理中使用“从包 / URL 安装”，填写 v0.1.0 安装包 URL：

```text
https://github.com/liuhuishang/dsh-five-session-evolution/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-five-session-evolution-0.1.0.tgz
```

[GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/liuhuishang/dsh-five-session-evolution) · [Release 安装包](https://github.com/liuhuishang/dsh-five-session-evolution/releases/tag/v0.1.0)

支持自定义 Discover 源的客户端，可在插件管理 → 发现 / Discover → 添加索引源中填入：

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liuhuishang/dsh-five-session-evolution/main/market-index.json
```

刷新后搜索 **五会话自进化** / **Five-session Evolution**。索引使用固定 40 位 Git 提交；添加此源后即可发现，社区市场的公共目录收录另行审核。请以你的客户端支持的安装来源为准。安装后检查 `five-session-evolution` 插件行已启用，使用下方状态工具确认加载。

市场维护流程见 [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md)。

本插件订阅 DSH 的根 Agent `agent/disposed` 生命周期。关闭、切换或清空会话是否触发计数，取决于当前客户端是否真正销毁该 Agent。**一条回答结束、一个 turn 结束、界面暂时闲置，都不等于一次会话结束。**

会话需要包含非空用户文本，并至少出现过一个 `turn/end`。失败或中断过的会话也可进入复盘，以便记录教训。新建空白会话跳过。计数从启用插件后实际观察到的结束事件开始，历史存档保持原样。

去重依据是项目目录和会话 ID。移动项目目录会形成新的记忆分区；符号链接路径可能形成不同分区。进程被强制终止时，尚未来得及持久化的结束事件可能丢失。推荐让 DSH 正常结束会话。

在已安装插件行的 `config` 中调整：

```yaml
batchSize: 5
injectMemory: true
timeoutMs: 300000
maxSessionChars: 12000

| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `batchSize` | 5 | 每批会话数，2–20；建议在批次处理完后调整 |
| `injectMemory` | true | 向根会话动态带入该项目的经验，最多约 10,000 个 JSON 字符 |
| `timeoutMs` | 300000 | 单次复盘截止时间，覆盖创建、初始化及模型轮次，10 秒至 30 分钟 |
| `maxSessionChars` | 12000 | 每个会话保留的末尾对话文本字符数，1,000–40,000 |
| `maxMemories` | 30 | 经验数量上限，1–100 |
| `maxCandidates` | 20 | 候选数量上限，1–100 |
| `maxAttempts` | 3 | 自动尝试次数，1–10 |
| `provider` / `model` | 空 | 两者都空则跟随当前 DSH 默认模型；固定模型时两者一起填写 |
切换配置保留已入队批次的原始成员。单项目最多保留 100,000 个已计数会话的哈希和 100 个待复盘批次；达到容量时停止新批次准入并记录警告，避免静默丢弃去重信息。

插件注册两个工具，可以直接对 DSH 说：

- “调用 `evolution_status`，显示这个项目的自进化进度和经验。”
- “调用 `evolution_retry`，重试这个项目最早的失败批次。”

`evolution_status` 返回计数、待满批数量、队列、经验、工作流候选、复盘摘要和最近错误，省略保留的对话正文。`evolution_retry` 重置队首批次的尝试次数并排队，运行时会消耗所选模型的 tokens。

经验通过动态系统提示段提供给后续根会话，并保留来源 ID。它们是可核查、可过时的参考资料；工作流候选可通过状态工具读取，再按项目的技能开发流程进行评估和安装。

- 持久记录位于 DSH storageDomain 的 `five_session_evolution` domain、`workspaces` 表中，物理位置由宿主存储配置决定。
- 本插件额外保留每个待处理会话的用户/助手文本摘录、会话 ID、时间与预设名；原始工具输出、隐藏推理和图片跳过。对话里的个人资料仍可能出现在摘录中。
- 提交前按常见令牌、Authorization、密码字段和私钥格式做尽力脱敏；格式之外的敏感文本仍可能保留。
- 复盘会把这一批摘录和已有经验发送到所选 DSH 模型提供方，并产生模型费用。它通常是一次模型轮次，实际请求量取决于提供方重试和错误重试。
- 成功提交后，本插件记录移除该批摘录；DSH 原有的会话日志、复盘 Agent 日志和备份仍由宿主保留策略管理。
- 复盘 Agent 隐藏工具 schema 并阻止工具执行；插件只接受经校验的结构化结果，并负责写入自己的 domain。
- 适用于一个写入 Host 管理同一存储；多个进程并发写同一后端尚未验证。卸载会停止后台任务并释放 domain，持久数据由宿主存储管理。

在与目标 DSH 版本匹配的开发环境中安装依赖，然后执行：

```sh
npm run check
npm test
npm pack --dry-run
```

测试覆盖第五次结束触发、去重、项目隔离、持久队列恢复、失败保留、来源校验、工具隔离，以及真实 Cordis 的插件加载和卸载。模型返回使用固定测试数据；实际模型联网和真实桌面完整流程需在安装后验收。

发布脚本、索引与社区提交步骤见 [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md)。

[中文](README.md) · MIT · DeepSeek Harness plugin

**Turn recurring project experience into lasting context: review every five distinct ended sessions, retain sourced lessons and workflow drafts, and bring project memory into later conversations.**

Built for long-lived coding, debugging, documentation and other repeated project work. State is isolated by working directory and stored in DSH. Reviews follow the current DSH default model unless a provider and model are explicitly configured. No separate memory-service account is required.

```text
5 distinct ended sessions in a workspace
  → durable queue
  → independent review Agent with no executable tools
  → structured-output and source-ID validation

The default batch size is five, configurable from two to twenty. A session ID counts once per workspace, including across restarts and repeated closes. Child Agents, review runners and sessions marked as automation, subagent or goal are excluded.

Each lesson and workflow draft must cite at least two different session IDs from the current batch. Validation checks structure and source membership; factual accuracy still requires checking project evidence. New lessons replace matching topics, and new drafts replace matching names. Defaults retain thirty lessons, twenty drafts and one hundred review summaries.

Queued batches survive restarts. Failures retry after sixty and one hundred twenty seconds; the third failed attempt pauses the workspace's oldest batch until a manual retry. A Host runs one review at a time. Applying the result and removing its batch happen in one durable record write. A crash can cause a model review to run again, but an applied result is not applied twice.

This improves context and reusable workflow knowledge. Model weights stay unchanged. Workflow candidates are stored as drafts; they require a separate evaluation and installation step. The plugin writes only its own storage domain.

Version 0.1.0 targets **DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 and Node.js 22+**. It uses DSH Agent, preset, model, tools and storageDomain services. The package includes a composition patch mounting one Host plugin.

Use the package/URL installation action in DSH plugin management with the v0.1.0 archive:

```text
https://github.com/liuhuishang/dsh-five-session-evolution/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-five-session-evolution-0.1.0.tgz
```

[GitHub repository](https://github.com/liuhuishang/dsh-five-session-evolution) · [Release downloads](https://github.com/liuhuishang/dsh-five-session-evolution/releases/tag/v0.1.0)

For clients supporting custom Discover sources, add this index under plugin management → Discover → Add index source:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liuhuishang/dsh-five-session-evolution/main/market-index.json
```

Refresh and search **Five-session Evolution**. The index pins its Git package source to a full 40-character commit. Adding this source enables discovery; acceptance into the public community catalog is a separate process. Use an installation source supported by your client. After installation, enable the `five-session-evolution` row and check its status tool. See [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md) for maintenance and community listing steps.

readme.section: What counts as an ended session?
readme.text: The trigger is a root Agent's `agent/disposed` lifecycle event. Whether closing, switching or clearing a conversation triggers it depends on the client actually disposing that Agent. A completed answer, completed turn or idle UI does not count by itself.

readme.section: What counts as an ended session?
readme.text: An eligible session contains nonempty user text and at least one `turn/end`. Failed or interrupted sessions can contribute lessons. Empty sessions are skipped. Collection starts with lifecycle events observed after activation; existing archives are not scanned retroactively.

readme.section: What counts as an ended session?
readme.text: Deduplication uses workspace path and session ID. Moving a project or opening it through another symbolic-link path can produce a different partition. Hard process termination can lose an event that was not yet committed; normal shutdown is preferable.

Edit the installed plugin row's `config`:

```yaml
batchSize: 5
injectMemory: true
timeoutMs: 300000
maxSessionChars: 12000

| Option | Default | Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `batchSize` | 5 | Sessions per batch, 2–20; change after pending work completes |
| `injectMemory` | true | Supply workspace lessons to root sessions; about 10,000 JSON characters |
| `timeoutMs` | 300000 | Review deadline including creation, initialization and the model turn, ten seconds to thirty minutes |
| `maxSessionChars` | 12000 | Tail of conversational text retained per session, 1,000–40,000 characters |
| `maxMemories` | 30 | Maximum lessons, 1–100 |
| `maxCandidates` | 20 | Maximum workflow drafts, 1–100 |
| `maxAttempts` | 3 | Automatic attempts, 1–10 |
| `provider` / `model` | empty | Both empty follow the DSH default; configure both to pin a route |

Already queued batches keep their membership after configuration changes. Admission stops with a warning at one hundred thousand counted session hashes or one hundred queued batches per workspace, rather than discarding deduplication history.

Ask DSH to call:

- `evolution_status`: counts, pending sessions, queue, sourced lessons, workflow drafts, summaries and the latest error. Retained transcript bodies are omitted.
- `evolution_retry`: reset attempts on the oldest batch and schedule another review. Model token costs apply.

Lessons are supplied through a dynamic system-prompt section as fallible reference data with source IDs. Draft workflows remain available through the status tool for evaluation and installation using the project's normal skill process.

State lives in the `five_session_evolution` storageDomain, table `workspaces`. The Host controls its physical location and backup policy.

Pending batches retain text excerpts, session IDs, timestamps and preset names. Tool output, hidden reasoning and images are omitted. Personal information in conversational text may remain. Common token formats, Authorization values, password-like fields and private-key blocks receive best-effort redaction; this does not guarantee removal of every secret.

A review sends the batch excerpts and existing memory to the selected DSH model provider and incurs model costs. A normal review is one model turn; provider retries and failed-review retries may add requests. After a successful commit, this plugin removes the batch excerpts from its record. Original DSH logs, review-Agent logs and backups follow Host retention settings.

The review Agent hides tool schemas and blocks tool execution. The plugin validates JSON before persisting its own records. One writing Host per storage backend is supported; concurrent processes writing the same backend have not been validated. Unloading stops work and closes the domain handle; durable data remains Host-managed.

Install dependencies matching the target DSH release, then run:

```sh
npm run check
npm test
npm pack --dry-run
```

Tests cover batching, deduplication, isolation, queue recovery, failed-review retention, evidence IDs, tool isolation and real Cordis load/unload. Model responses use fixtures. Live model and desktop lifecycle acceptance should be performed after installation.

See [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md) for release instructions.
